completion_data.completion_summary: Fixed 4 bugs in artifact counter system: reviser now increments counter on each revision, disk reconciliation added to all skills to handle legacy counter drift, collision detection added to prevent filename collisions, and documentation updated to clarify plan_version is metadata-only.

memory_candidates.content: Disk reconciliation pattern for artifact counter systems: use `find ... -name '[0-9][0-9]_*.md' | sed 's|.*/([0-9][0-9])_.*|\1|' | sort -n | tail -1` to find the max artifact number on disk. Always strip leading zeros with `$((10#$max_on_disk))` to prevent octal interpretation in bash. Compare with counter and advance if behind.
